You may have read in the newspaper that successful workers, engineers and even executives at top companies in the USA have some plans on Europe’s Third Programme scheme. The “Third Programme” involves students with a good mathematics/social sciences background, in particular at forms A and B, to become £3,604 million EU scholarship.
